raised: Doesn't know what to do next: where to buy a money-market fund, whether their bank sells one, or what it costs
The page never says where the S&P 500 fits
The '123 מקמר / מחושב / הזנת' line makes no sense to them
The fee-plan paragraph gives transaction counts but not what each plan costs
The calculator shows 5% growth on a current account that earns nothing, and it's unclear what the example represents
The 'מזומן שקלי' button makes no sense to them
The BANK-xx tags mean nothing (ignored; would drop)
The 'מי מציע ומי מפקח' block didn't help their decision (would drop)
The 'כסף נכנס ויוצא' cards don't answer their question (would drop)
'כמה זה עולה' gives no actual fee number, only 'לפי התעריפון'
The third tax card (linked interest, 25%) went over their head
The red 'שאלה פתוחה' box with codes looked broken
Worried by 'no deposit insurance in Israel'
The padlock section 'מה האתר לקח בחשבון' is just codes (would drop)
The terms table appears twice
The chart's pink line and lighter line aren't labelled
The deposits figure of ₪62,681 doesn't match their own sum of ₪70,000
They don't see the difference between the 'בכסף של היום' and 'בשקלים של העתיד' toggles
The 'חוקים וכללים' column is empty
Doesn't understand 'מנת הקישו להסבר'
'מק"ם' isn't explained
Linkage terms ('לא צמוד', 'ריבית צמודה למדד') are unclear
Unclear how long redeeming fund units on a trading day takes
No figure for how much money in the current account loses to inflation; the calculator shows something else
No guidance on how much to keep in the current account

problems.why: The reader complains that the calculator shows 5% growth even though current-account money earns nothing, and they can't tell whether it shows their own case. That is the person's point that the interest example and chart are presented as general when most idle money earns nothing.
